info.title: WebScheduler Local online bookings API
info.description: Read and book a business's appointments from your own programs. Each key belongs to one business and acts as the person who made it.

get.description:
The business the key belongs to, its time zone and booking rules.

Scope: `catalogue.read`.

Services that can be booked, archived ones left out.

Scope: `catalogue.read`.

People who can be booked. A key of a team member or reception sees only the people they work with.

Scope: `catalogue.read`.

One team member, with the services they offer.

Scope: `catalogue.read`.

The profile's main address and its branches.

Scope: `catalogue.read`.

Free start times for a service on one day. Leave provider_id out for anyone (admin keys only).

Scope: `availability.read`.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: YYYY-MM-DD in the business's time zone.

parameters.name: as
parameters.description: customer (default): the rules customers book under. business: every free minute in working time.

get.description:
Appointments, earliest first. A key of a team member or reception sees only the people they work with.

Scope: `appointments.read`.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: YYYY-MM-DD (business time) or ISO 8601: appointments ending after it.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: YYYY-MM-DD (to the end of that day) or ISO 8601: appointments starting before it.

parameters.name: updated_since
parameters.description: ISO 8601: only appointments changed since then. Handy to keep a copy up to date.

post.description:
Book as the business does from its calendar: any free time in working hours. The same checks, messages and webhooks as a booking made in the calendar; source is api.

Scope: `appointments.write`.

A new time, and optionally a new team member. Upcoming appointments only.

Scope: `appointments.write`.

Confirm, cancel, mark completed or no show.

Scope: `appointments.write`.

The business's notes on the appointment.

Scope: `appointments.write`.

first_name is required. An email may belong to one customer only.

Scope: `customers.write`.

Only the fields sent change.

Scope: `customers.write`.
Sent to the business's webhook address. Check the WebScheduler-Signature header before trusting it.

200.description: Any 2xx answer means received. Anything else, or no answer in 10 seconds, is tried again after 1, 5, 30, 120 and 360 minutes.

Provider.description: A team member who can be booked.

id.description: null is the profile's main address.

customer_id.description: An existing customer. Or send customer.

delivery_mode.description: One the service offers. The service's first when left out.

Unauthenticated.description: No key, or a key that is unknown, revoked or expired.

Forbidden.description: The key lacks the scope, its person's role does not allow it, or the business no longer takes bookings.

RateLimited.description: More than 120 requests a minute. Wait for Retry-After seconds.

NotFound.description: Not found, or not in this key's reach.

Invalid.description: Something sent is missing or wrong; details.fields says what.
